name: Cedar House Workshops

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 2 / label3.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 2 / footer.

recognitionRules: Use Copperplate display lettering between restrained horizontal rules.
Keep cream on deep teal as the principal poster relationship; brass accents frame rather than fill text.
Separate the date, venue, access and booking lines so decoration never hides attendance details.
Pair the poster face with a plain programme reverse.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: From sheet to story, one fold at a time.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use CEDAR HOUSE in Copperplate above a stepped rule, with WORKSHOPS as a smaller descriptor. A corner-step motif may frame signs without becoming a crest.
invariants: Use Copperplate display lettering between restrained horizontal rules.
Keep cream on deep teal as the principal poster relationship; brass accents frame rather than fill text.
Separate the date, venue, access and booking lines so decoration never hides attendance details.
adaptations: Use the full ornamental frame on posters and one header rule on handouts.
Let workshop titles change while the host masthead remains stable.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Copperplate is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
